sv.title: Teknikjätten prisfuskade – myndigheten vill utkräva vite
sv.summary: Kjell & Company skrev inte ut varornas billigaste pris under senaste månaden. I stället framställdes en prishöjning som rabatt. Nu vill konsumentombudsmannen att företaget ska betala vite om miljonbelopp.

en.title: Tech giant price-fixed – authority wants to claim penalty
en.summary: Kjell & Company did not display the lowest price of its goods during the most recent month. Instead, a price increase was presented as a discount. Now the consumer ombudsman wants the company to pay a penalty of millions.
